headword: {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}

definitions.explanation: A condition where vehicles on a road are moving very slowly or not at all due to heavy traffic volume, accidents, or road work.

examples.japanese: {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}で{遅刻|ちこく}した。
examples.english: I was late because of a traffic jam.

examples.japanese: {連休|れんきゅう}はいつも{交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}がひどい。
examples.english: Traffic congestion is always terrible during long weekends.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}の{影響|えいきょう}で{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}に{交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}が{発生|はっせい}している。
examples.english: Traffic congestion has occurred on the highway due to an accident.

notes:
{交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい} is composed of {交通|こうつう} (traffic) + {渋滞|じゅうたい} (congestion, stagnation).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}が{発生|はっせい}する: traffic congestion occurs
- {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる: to get caught in a traffic jam
- {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}を{避|さ}ける: to avoid traffic congestion
- {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい}{情報|じょうほう}: traffic congestion information

USAGE: In casual speech, {渋滞|じゅうたい} alone is more common. The full form {交通渋滞|こうつうじゅうたい} is used in news reports, official announcements, and more formal contexts.
